description: This file is a shell script used for testing Git repository states and file contents, primarily involving setting, saving, verifying, and checking the status of files in a Git working directory.

methods.name: set_state
methods.description: Prepare the content for a given path in the working tree and index.

methods.name: save_state
methods.description: Save the current index and worktree content of a specified path into backup files.

methods.name: set_and_save_state
methods.description: Combine setting state and saving state into a single operation.

methods.name: verify_state
methods.description: Verify that the worktree and index contents of a file match expected values.

methods.name: verify_saved_state
methods.description: Verify that the saved state of a file matches the last saved content.

methods.name: save_head
methods.description: Save the current HEAD revision hash.

methods.name: verify_saved_head
methods.description: Verify that the current HEAD hash matches the previously saved hash.
